items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: some of the books say that Walter Page, with Basie was one -- was the first person to play four beats.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's at the base of everything, that nice heartbeat. That's good, that four beats. So maybe in the revival music, the so-called Dixieland revival, maybe some of those people played more two beats. But Pops always played four, and he always said it was always -- you played four, and some of the books say that Walter Page, with Basie was one -- was the first person to play four beats. That's of course not true. So we're setting a lot of things straight, and that's good. Did -- in New Orleans, did they like…
